2.heading: FROM THE DIRECTOR'S DESK
2.transcript:
From the Director's Desk. The Directors of Orange O Tec Pvt. Ltd. are Aayush Rathi, Karan Toshniwal, Shivkishan Rathi and Sushil Toshniwal.

"Let's give our best and excel, always"

As a progressive company, committed equally to the environment and our clientele, we at Orange, consider our team members as our biggest assets. Any company's success and more importantly, its reputation is built and maintained by its team members. And hence, Human Resources department plays a significant role in fostering a positive work environment and boosting member productivity. At Orange, we have always focused on building a team of talented and skilled professionals. Now, it is our constant endeavor to provide the team with the best facilities and conducive work environment to shine out. Humans and culture are intertwined with a company's success. With this HR Manual, I am sure that we will have a set of standard guidelines to pursue excellence in everything we do. Our HR department will also strive for ensuring the well-being and personal development of our team members. This manual is yet another example that your company cares for you! Stay committed, stay productive, the company is always with you.

3.heading: DESIGNATION HIERARCHY
3.transcript:
Designation Hierarchy (the grade ladder, top to bottom).

At the top: Aayush Rathi, Director; and Karan Toshniwal, Director.
Reporting to them: Manmohan Totla, Director - Sales Other than West Region; and Nakuleshwar Sharm, Director - Sales West Region.

Below the Directors the ladder runs across three parallel tracks.

Senior levels, equivalent across the tracks:
- Senior General Manager = Vice President / Assistant Vice President = C-Level employes
- General Manager = Deputy General Manager = Head of Department / Division Head
- Deputy Manager = Manager = Senior Manager

Management and engineering track, descending: Assistant Manager, then Senior Engineer, Engineer, Junior / Associate Engineer, Trainee.

Executive track, descending: Senior Executive, Executive, Junior / Associate, Trainee.

Plant and operations track, descending: Senior Supervisor, Floor Supervisor, Junior Supervisor, Senior Operator, Operator, Junior Operator, Trainee Operator, Helper.

6.heading: PREFACE
6.transcript:
Preface.

At Orange, we have always focused on creating an encouraging work environment that can boost our individual and collective productivity further.

As a concerned and committed corporate citizen, at Orange, we are always eager to set high standards of human resources management.

This manual is designed to serve as the primary source of information for team members regarding human resources policies, programmes, and procedures. The purpose of this manual is to serve as a reference for the managers, supervisors, and other team members so that human resources issues can be dealt with more consistently and fairly across our operations.

The guidelines outlined here have been crafted with an aim to serve as a sort of code of conduct that encourages law-abiding, human-centric work practices.

This manual must be followed in all situations unless an exception is granted by the management of the company. This manual supersedes all previous personnel policies and procedures. The manual will be reviewed at a regular interval and updated as and when required.
